evals.prompt: Check that every task in wp-02 is verified and findings.md is present, then advance its status.
evals.expected_output: Fires. Confirms all tasks are verified and findings.md exists, then advances the WP status to verified. Fourth step of the chain.

evals.prompt: Verify wp-04 — I just finished it.
evals.expected_output: Fires — resolves wp-04, runs the completion checks, and stamps status: verified, or reports exactly which check failed.

evals.prompt: Confirm wp-05 meets its declared completion criteria and mark it verified.
evals.expected_output: Fires. Evaluates the WP against its goal-declared completion strategy and advances status only when every task check passes.

evals.prompt: The work package hasn't been run yet — dispatch its tasks.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire: there is nothing to verify until the WP has been executed. The `implement` command owns dispatching a ready WP through `execute`.

evals.prompt: The whole feature is done — write a retrospective across its work packages.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — a cross-WP retrospective is not a per-WP completion check. `verify` owns the last-WP whole-feature integration review, the closest in-package analog.

evals.prompt: Two reviewers disagree about whether wp-04 actually meets its goal. Settle it.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire, and this is the discriminating pair: adjudicating conflicting judgements is not running the deterministic completion check. `verify` gate C escalates judge/second-opinion disagreement to the human — it never breaks the tie itself.

evals.prompt: Keep an eye on the running chain and flag it if a stage stalls.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — monitoring an in-flight chain is not a WP completion check. `run` owns chain-level driving and resume, the closest in-package owner.
